# Narrative Detection & Profiling Pipeline - dependencies
#
# Generated by scanning actual `import` statements across src/narrative_lens/ and experiments/
# (2026), then pinned to the versions verified working in this project's local CPU-only
# environment (`pip freeze`). See README.md "Quick Start" for setup instructions.
#
# Relationship to pyproject.toml: pyproject.toml declares the *unpinned* dependency set needed
# to import/run narrative_lens as an installable package (`pip install -e .`), so the project
# works across Python/OS versions without being locked to exact versions that may not exist
# everywhere. requirements.txt is the companion *pinned lock file* - the exact versions actually
# verified to work together on this project's local CPU-only Windows environment. Use
# `pip install -r requirements.txt` to reproduce that exact environment, or
# `pip install -e .` (optionally with `[dev]`/`[datacollection]` extras) for a looser, portable
# install. Both files must be updated together when a dependency is added/removed.
#
# torch note: this project runs CPU-only locally. The pinned build below (`+cpu`) comes from
# PyTorch's dedicated CPU wheel index, NOT the default PyPI index:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
# If you have a CUDA-capable GPU, first install a matching CUDA build of torch yourself
# (see https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/), then run
# `pip install -r requirements.txt --no-deps torch` skipped (comment out the torch line below).

# --- Core scientific / data stack -------------------------------------------------------
numpy==2.2.5
pandas==2.2.3
matplotlib==3.10.9          # analyze_agendas.py (agenda/rhetoric plots)
pyyaml==6.0.3                # configs/*.yaml loading (narrative_lens.utils.config_loader)

# --- Deep learning / transformer-based feature extractors --------------------------------
# Used by: ner.py, srl.py, emotion.py, reliability.py, stance.py, fusion.py, train.py,
# train_topics.py, and every experiments/ script that trains or loads a model.
torch==2.13.0+cpu
transformers==5.15.0
sentence-transformers==5.7.0
spacy==3.8.15
# spaCy transformer pipeline used by srl.py (advcl/SRL extraction) - installed as a direct
# wheel, not from PyPI's package index. Alternative: `python -m spacy download en_core_web_trf`.
en_core_web_trf @ https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/download/en_core_web_trf-3.8.0/en_core_web_trf-3.8.0-py3-none-any.whl
sentencepiece==0.2.2         # DeBERTa-v2/v3 slow-tokenizer conversion (narrative_stance_entity.py's ABSA model)
protobuf==7.36.1             # required alongside sentencepiece for the same tokenizer conversion path

# --- Topic modeling ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Used by: train_topics.py, stance.py, analyze_soft_topic_quality.py, analyze_soft_topics.py,
# and all of experiments/topic_modeling/*.py + experiments/feature_ablation/*.py.
bertopic==0.17.4
umap-learn==0.5.12
hdbscan==0.8.44
gensim==4.4.0                # only experiment_e_lda_baseline.py (LDA benchmark) and
                              # narrative_topic_compare.py's "lda" topic-feature variant

# --- Classic ML / evaluation utilities -----------------------------------------------------
scikit-learn==1.9.0
tqdm==4.70.0

# --- Data collection (web scraping) - CPU-only, no GPU needed ------------------------------
selenium==4.46.0              # build_twitter_dataset.py
webdriver-manager==4.1.2      # build_twitter_dataset.py (Microsoft Edge driver)

# --- Development / CI tooling ----------------------------------------------------------------
pytest==9.1.1                 # tests/ suite
ruff==0.16.6                  # lint/format check (see .github/workflows/ci.yml)
